name: Tuluun
summary: Tuluun is a Broken shaman trainer who guides novices in communion with the elements. Despite the vital guidance he offers to spiritual seekers, his presence draws open suspicion and accusations of heresy from traditional draenei devoted strictly to the Holy Light.

sections.title: A Precarious Calling
sections.body: As one of the Broken, Tuluun embodies the physical and spiritual mutation wrought upon his people by demonic corruption. Severed from the Light, Broken like Tuluun turned toward the elemental spirits of the world for purpose and strength. Even as he shares this spiritual knowledge with pupils seeking balance with earth, fire, and water, traditional draenei view his ways with deep apprehension, occasionally berating him for spreading what they consider heretical blasphemy.

faq.answer: Tuluun is a Broken shaman trainer who teaches new practitioners how to commune with the spirits of nature and forge connections to the elemental powers.

faq.q: Why are other draenei hostile toward him?
faq.answer: Many orthodox draenei are intensely devoted to the Holy Light and view the Broken with unease. When Broken turn to shamanism, conservative draenei often regard communion with raw elemental forces as dangerous or heretical compared to the purity of the Light.

faq.q: What elemental rites does he oversee?
faq.answer: Tuluun directs initiates through pivotal spiritual trials, guiding them to commune with elemental spirits and claim their fundamental totems, including the elements of Fire and Water.

angles.text: For shamans walking the path of harmony, Tuluun offers direct instruction on answering the calls of fire and water despite the surrounding social scorn.
Tuluun's strained presence highlights the cultural frictions simmering within new allies trying to balance strict holy tradition with the primal paths of survival.
